Package index

Fit the model

bayes_efron_fit() fits the model. ?bef_fit describes the fitted object and its methods.

bayes_efron_fit()
Fit the Bayesian Efron log-spline model to estimates and standard errors
print(<bef_fit>) summary(<bef_fit>) summary(<bef_fit_re>) print(<summary.bef_fit>) coef(<bef_fit_re>) confint(<bef_fit_re>) vcov(<bef_fit_re>) fitted(<bef_fit_re>) as.data.frame(<bef_fit_re>) nobs(<bef_fit>) logLik(<bef_fit>) as_draws(<bef_fit>) format(<bef_fit>) quantile(<bef_fit_re>) format(<summary.bef_fit>) residuals(<bef_fit_re>) simulate(<bef_fit_re>) ndraws(<bef_fit>) variables(<bef_fit>) AIC(<bef_fit>) BIC(<bef_fit>)
Fitted Efron log-spline model objects
predict(<bef_fit_re>)
Posterior predictive distribution for a new site

Prepare the data and the grid

Check the estimates and their standard errors, and build the grid and the spline basis on which the distribution of effects is represented.

as_bef_data() print(<bef_data>) summary(<bef_data>) format(<bef_data>) as.data.frame(<bef_data>)
Extract estimates and standard errors from a data frame or list
make_efron_grid() format(<bef_grid>) print(<bef_grid>)
Build the grid and spline basis for the distribution of effects

Summarize a fit

The estimated distribution of effects and the posterior distributions of the site effects, as data frames.

g_summary()
Summarize the estimated distribution of effects
site_summary() exceedance_prob()
Summarize the posterior distributions of the site effects

Check a fit

Sampler and grid diagnostics.

diagnose() print(<bef_diagnostic>) summary(<bef_diagnostic>) as.data.frame(<bef_diagnostic>) format(<bef_diagnostic>) nuts_params(<bef_fit>) log_posterior(<bef_fit>) rhat(<bef_fit>) neff_ratio(<bef_fit>)
MCMC convergence and grid diagnostics for a fitted model

Plots

Each plot function returns a ggplot object. plot() on a fit calls them by type.

plot(<bef_fit_re>)
Plot a fitted model

Results

plot_g()
Density and CDF plots of the estimated distribution of effects
plot_sites()
Caterpillar (forest) plot of the site effects
plot_shrinkage()
Shrinkage plot of posterior means against estimates
plot_exceedance()
Plot the exceedance probabilities of the site effects
plot_site_posterior()
Plot the posterior distribution of individual site effects

Checks of a fit

plot_diagnostics()
Plot sampler diagnostics and grid diagnostics
plot_loo()
Plot the Pareto k values of leave-one-out cross-validation
plot_ppc()
Posterior predictive check
plot_mcmc()
Trace plots and other MCMC plots with bayesplot

Grids and simulated data

plot(<bef_grid>)
Plot a grid and its spline basis with the estimates
plot(<bef_grid_comparison>)
Plot the sensitivity of the results to the grid
plot_recovery()
Plot the recovery of true effects in simulated data

Compare models

Leave-one-out cross-validation, a comparison of fits with different grids and spline bases, and the estimate of g in the form that the empirical Bayes functions of the ebnm package take.

loo(<bef_fit>) waic(<bef_fit>)
Leave-one-out cross-validation and WAIC for a fitted model
compare_efron_grids() print(<bef_grid_comparison>)
Compare fits on several grids (sensitivity analysis)
as_normalmix()
Export the estimated distribution of effects for the ebnm package

Compile the model

Compile the Stan program before the first fit, or delete the compiled model.

bayes_efron_compile() bayes_efron_clear_cache()
Compile the Stan programs before the first fit

Data sets and stored fits

Example data, and fits of them that are stored in the package so that the examples run without CmdStan.

Callback gaps of 97 firms, and 1,500 simulated sites (Lee and Sui, 2025)

krw_discrimination
Racial callback gaps among 97 large firms
krw_fit
Model fitted to the racial callback gaps
twin_towers
Twin Towers simulated data
twin_towers_fit
Model fitted to the Twin Towers simulated data

A small meta-analysis (19 teacher expectancy studies)

raudenbush1985
Teacher expectancy studies
raudenbush_fit
Model fitted to the teacher expectancy studies

A multisite trial in education (79 schools of Project STAR)

star_schools
Small-class effects in 79 schools of Project STAR
